parents.subject: Russian, East European and Eurasian Studies

ns2:section.sectionText: An anthropological approach to Central and Inner Asia, encompassing the former Soviet "stans" as well as Xinjiang, Mongolia, and Tuva. Emphasis on contemporary cultural issues with a look at historical and political aspects as they relate to current social contexts. Topics include: ethnicity, minority/majority issues, and tational building; women and Islam; Sufism, animism, and pilgrimage; midicine and healing; nomadism, settlement, and the environment; nationalism and music; and the transnational context of Central Asia. Meets with REES 496 (cross-listed with ANTH 515 1G and ANTH 399 1U).
